title: How fast a thermocouple responds
caption: After a sudden change, a first-order sensor approaches the new value as 1 − e^(−t/τ). With τ = 0.5 s it reaches 63% after one τ and is within 1% after τ ln 100 = 4.6τ ≈ 2.3 s.
alt: Percentage of the final reading against time, rising steeply and levelling at 100%, with marks at 0.5 seconds (63%) and 2.3 seconds (99%).
description: Reading as a percentage of the step: 100(1 − e^(−t/τ)), τ = 0.5 s.
At t = τ = 0.5 s it is 63% of the way.
Within 1% when e^(−t/τ) = 0.01: t = τ ln 100 = 2.30 s.
